copied-label.description: Polite announcement after a successful write. Override for localized interfaces.

feedback-duration.description:

component.description: Copies text to the clipboard and confirms the result in the same button.

ki-copy.description: Fired after a successful clipboard write. The detail carries the exact text copied.

ki-copy-error.description: Fired when the source cannot be read or clipboard writing is unavailable or fails.

button.description: Native copy control with keyboard and pointer activation.

icon.description: Fixed-size decorative feedback glyph box inside the button.

label.description: Wrapper around the visible slotted label.

copiedLabel.description: Polite announcement after a successful write. Override for localized interfaces.

copyErrorLabel.description: Polite announcement after a failed write or missing source. Override for localized interfaces.

feedbackDuration.description:
Milliseconds to show feedback after a write settles. Zero keeps the
outcome visible until the next result. Invalid values use 1500 ms.

from.description:
ID of a source in this button's document or shadow root. A nonempty ID
takes precedence over `value`. The source's current string value or
its text content is read on activation.

label.description: Accessible name for the icon-only control. Visible slot text supplies the name when present.

size.description: Token-backed button size. Match the size of adjacent controls.

value.description: Exact clipboard text, including whitespace. Supply it when the text is known directly.

variant.description: Button emphasis. Use ghost for compact actions and secondary for a visible supporting action.

slots.description:
Optional visible text, which supplies the accessible name and
places the icon at the inline start. Use plain text or non-interactive markup.
